tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: The correct order of radii is

solution.text:
Effective nuclear charge (i,e. Z/e ratio) decreases from $\mathrm{F}^{-}$ to $\mathrm{N}^{3-}$ hence the radii follows the order: $\mathrm{F}^{-}<\mathrm{O}^{2-}<\mathrm{N}^{3-} . \mathrm{Z} / \mathrm{e}$ for
$\mathrm{F}^{-}=9 / 10=0.9,$ for $\mathrm{O}^{2-}=8 / 10=.8,$ for $\mathrm{N}^{3-}=0.7$
